name: Amco India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Amco India Ltd manufactures PVC Leather cloth and aluminum foils[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) PVC Leather cloth
b) PVC films and sheeting
c) Laminated Foil
d) Blister pack & strip pack plain or printed

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.35% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.65% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.82 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 47.4 to 60.4 days.
